dropped.name: __meta
dropped.why: the Rivet runtime's note of when an object's engine alarm was set; with the engine gone, an object's wake-up is a row in its process's wake file (runtime/actor.ts, the table wakes), and __meta is left unread

dropped.name: views
dropped.why: #57: when each person last opened each app, only for the gallery's New to you and Updated since you opened it, which the gallery no longer says; WorkspaceDO drops the table on start

dropped.name: SiteDO
dropped.why: #24: sites became apps (AppDO), a hard cut: every app's files and data were dropped

dropped.name: sites
dropped.why: #24: WorkspaceDO's app registry is apps now, a hard cut

dropped.name: environment_sites
dropped.why: #24: WorkspaceDO's preview environment members are environment_apps now, a hard cut

dropped.name: connection_clients
dropped.why: oauth-engine: OpenBelt registers once per authorization server and workspace host (signin_clients), with that registration's own redirect URI. Only the unreleased OAuth branch had this table (never on main, staging or prod): a sign-in made with it is refused on its next refresh, saying to connect again

dropped.name: access_checks
dropped.why: Access's saved checks (answers rechecked on each visit) went with the Access page: Activity lists the calls themselves, and Check access answers one at a time. WorkspaceDO drops the table on start

dropped.name: directory.tags
dropped.why: App tags were removed. Directory.open drops this column on startup; existing version files stay content-addressed and unchanged, and new openbelt.json files reject tags as an unknown key.
